stories.title: Distance Field Contract for Chat Messages
stories.description: Define and enforce the frontend contract for provider distance fields (distance_miles:number, distance_text:string) within chat message payloads to ensure consistent parsing and rendering in MessageBubble.

stories.title: Distance Formatting Logic
stories.description: Implement client-side formatting logic to normalize backend distance values into consistent, user-friendly strings (rounded miles, unit standardization, and null-safe fallback such as hiding distance when absent).

stories.title: Render Distance in MessageBubble UI
stories.description: Enhance MessageBubble component to display formatted distance inline with provider results (e.g., next to name or address) while preserving markdown rendering, spacing, and readability constraints.

stories.title: End-to-End Distance Data Integration
stories.description: Ensure distance values generated by backend (MAINT-DIST) propagate through FindCare facade and tool_router into chat response payloads, aligning exactly with the frontend contract without transformation loss or schema mismatch.

stories.title: Distance Display Test Coverage
stories.description: Add unit and UI tests validating distance formatting, rendering in MessageBubble, contract compliance, and graceful handling of missing or malformed distance values across chat responses.
